blocks.html:
Wall Decals

Looking to add your style and personality to your walls like your office or your garage? Add vinyl wall decals to any flat surface inside or outside. A quick search on Google revealed thousands of options, here are some of the ideas we found online. Whether you are a petrolhead, have a favourite car brand, or looking for art. We have loads of options that Vinyl Wrap Toronto can we can design and size to match your needs. We can take a standard wall and turn it into a talking point.

Visit our shop to see Vinyl Wrap Toronto’s brick wall that features in many of the photos online. We also have a Porsche wall decal in black on an orange wall in our production area. Want to add a splash to your working area, try the desk decal we did for the front desk.

Vinyl Wrap Toronto specializes in wrapping vehicles, but it’s not all we do. Stickers and signs are something we like doing as they are an easy way to customize anything. We can personalize your vehicle, wall or floor quickly and much cheaper than a full wrap. The 3M and Avery Dennison types of vinyl that we use to make the wall decals are quick and easy to install. We also use specialty vinyl like cling and brick wrap depending on the wall and job.

Speak to our design team today about your vision and ideas. Click here to view more of our wall graphics.
Like us on Facebook, Follow us on Instagram, Heart us on Twitter and add a Comment on Pinterest.

Visit us 24 Ronson Dr, Etobicoke. We are at the 401 and Kipling. Call us at 416-746-1381 to speak to our team.
